title: Nonzero-charge matter and closed-face holonomy joint-cylinder compatibility on the stable strip

parents.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned researcher-owned extension. It does not edit, supersede or retroactively complete PAH-001 or any predecessor contract.

exact_scope.carrier_family: The PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n. The first two squares are split in G_2; G_3 splits the next frontier square, so the retained anchor closure and the first split triangular face are unchanged for this comparison.
exact_scope.anchors: a=(0,0) is the retained matter anchor and O,C are the strip anchors. The audited anchor-preserving automorphism group is the identity.
exact_scope.comparison: The exact finite comparison is the neutral coordinate inclusion J_(2,3): G_2 -> G_3. Level 1 is retained only as the G_1 -> G_2 matter-transfer boundary control from PAH-OMC-006.
exact_scope.state_domain: The audited finite states have one radial occupation quantum at exactly one of the four anchor-patch vertices a,b,c,d, zero radial occupation on remote vertices, all four patch phases in Z_2, all five patch links in Z_2, and all patch aperture bits. Thus Q=1 is nonzero and the state count is explicit.
exact_scope.functional: Evaluate exactly the displayed PAH-001 F_rho: aperture onsite and matter polynomial, aperture edge stiffness, covariant matter edge term, and plaquette Wilson term. No term or coupling is added.
exact_scope.joint_observable: H_0 is the Z_2 holonomy of the first split triangle with oriented boundary h00, v1, and d0^{-1}; in Z_2 its character is sign(u_h00) sign(u_v1) sign(u_d0). The cylinder basis is every bounded function of (ell_a,H_0), with ell_a the anchor matter density.
exact_scope.moves: Use the unchanged PAH directed roots. Radial-transfer roots on h00,v0,d0 can change ell_a; link roots LK(h00,sigma), LK(v1,sigma), LK(d0,sigma) can change H_0; all phase, aperture, remote radial and non-triangle link roots have zero increment on the joint cylinder.
exact_scope.normalization: Finite counting-measure Gibbs midpoint rates exactly as in PAH-001; no averaging over dropped variables is used. Radial and link roots carry the unchanged endpoint mobility and exact midpoint exponent.
exact_scope.limit: No cutoff, volume, lattice, continuum, phase, beta or observation limit is taken. n is only a finite geometric refinement label.

maps.geometric_inclusion: J_(2,3) retains every G_2 vertex, edge, aperture, phase, radial occupation and link coordinate by geometric ID; new G_3 coordinates are appended with neutral aperture, zero radial occupation and neutral Z_2 labels. Since the old state has Q=1, J preserves Q.
maps.local_restriction: The joint interaction closure is the union of the matter closure for h00,v0,d0 and the closed-face link closure for h00,v1,d0. It contains the four patch vertices, the five patch edges and the two split faces, and is identical in G_2 and G_3.
maps.observable_lift: I_(2,3)f is the same pointwise coordinate cylinder f(ell_a,H_0) on both finite state spaces; it is not a conditional expectation and is defined on every fine state.
maps.root_correspondence: Each retained radial or triangular link root has the same admissibility, exact energy increment, endpoint mobility, midpoint exponent and joint-observable increment in G_2 and G_3. The K=2 sigma=+1 and sigma=-1 link channels remain distinct counted roots even when their state maps coincide.

gauge_and_anchor_invariance.gauge_action: g in Z_2^V shifts phase n_v by g_v and carried link exponent u_(v,w) by g_w-g_v; ell and aperture are fixed.
gauge_and_anchor_invariance.closed_face_cancellation: The oriented triangle incidence is (g_b-g_a)+(g_d-g_b)-(g_d-g_a)=0, so H_0 is gauge invariant. The matter coordinate ell_a is gauge neutral. A pure link coordinate such as u_d0 is not admitted as a cylinder.
gauge_and_anchor_invariance.anchor_action: Only the identity automorphism is used, so the displayed cylinder is anchor preserving. No nontrivial symmetry average is inserted.

compatibility_proposition.statement: For every audited Q=1 patch state, the complete retained root list for the joint cylinder coordinates (ell_a,H_0) is identical under the neutral inclusion J_(2,3): radial roots incident to a and both sigma channels for each of h00,v1,d0 link roots have identical exact tuples (state, family, cell, direction, DeltaF, mobility^2, Delta ell_a, Delta H_0, midpoint exponent). All other PAH roots have zero increment on every bounded function of (ell_a,H_0).
proof_obligations: The radial energy difference is the exact sum of changed endpoint onsite and incident covariant terms; its support is unchanged between G_2 and G_3.
A triangular link root changes only its covariant edge term and Wilson face terms containing that edge; the first split triangle incidence is unchanged between G_2 and G_3.
The closed-face incidence cancellation proves H_0 gauge invariance, while ell_a is neutral and the anchor automorphism group is the identity.
The neutral inclusion preserves Q=1, every retained patch coordinate and every retained directed root channel, including the two K=2 link labels.
The G_1 -> G_2 matter-transfer control retains the known nonzero boundary defect and is not included in the stable proposition.
compatibility_proposition.cumulative_consequence: The finite joint cylinder has zero geometric generator defect for the G_2 -> G_3 comparison. No supremum over all cylinders, volumes, regulators, phases or limit parameters is asserted.

finite_acceptance.primary: Enumerate every fixture state and every retained radial/link root, evaluate exact local differences of the full displayed PAH energy, cross-check the local formula against full energy on bounded samples, and compare rootwise digests between G_2 and G_3.
finite_acceptance.independent: Rebuild the carrier, gauge-invariant holonomy, matter values, all PAH energy terms, local root differences and midpoint rows from direct formulas without importing the primary implementation.
finite_acceptance.hostile: Reject a pure non-gauge-invariant link cylinder, an open-face holonomy, omitted Wilson/covariant terms, collapsed K=2 channels, premature G_1 -> G_2 extension, fitted rates, conditional averaging and physical promotion.
finite_acceptance.lean: Cross-check charge, state count, closed-face gauge cancellation, K=2 channel multiplicity, root identity, boundary defect and the non-promotion firewall. Lean is a finite algebraic cross-check, not a global theorem formalization.

known_boundaries.boundary_control: The G_1 -> G_2 h00 matter-transfer control remains Delta F 0 versus -1; the first split boundary is not promoted.
known_boundaries.local_only: The proposition covers the joint cylinder (ell_a,H_0) on one Q=1 finite strip fixture. It does not cover arbitrary matter, link, plaquette or radial cylinders, or a global common algebra.
known_boundaries.fixture_only: Q=1, K=2, M_s=M_psi=1 and the displayed unit couplings are a finite researcher fixture. No parameter-uniform theorem is claimed.
known_boundaries.no_global_uniformity: Exact rootwise equality at G_2 -> G_3 does not establish a regulator-, volume- or source-uniform interaction estimate, an infinite-volume generator, or an ordered limit.
known_boundaries.no_physics: The Markov time and Q=1 sector are not quantum time, a physical sector, a vacuum, Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, a continuum or a mass gap.
